rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something can be done or obtained without difficulty.

example.english: You can readily buy this phone here.
example.traditional: 呢部手機喺呢度好容易買到。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 hai2 ni1 dou6 hou2 jung4 ji6 maai5 dou3

rows.note: Use this when someone responds, agrees, or acts promptly and without hesitation.

example.english: They readily agreed to help me move house.
example.traditional: 佢爽快咁答應咗幫我搬屋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 song2 faai3 gam3 daap3 jing3 zo2 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1

rows.note: Use this for the willingness part of the meaning, when someone is happy to do something rather than reluctant.

example.english: I readily agree to go with you to see the doctor.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jyun6 ji3 pui4 nei5 heoi3 gin3 ji1 saang1
